interfaces.name: Root air drying
interfaces.function: Assemble a reusable stone-and-bark tray, process actual roots and allow weather-dependent drying with reversible preservation while sufficiently dry.
interfaces.costs: Build: two stone units and one bark, two rounds at one energy. Load: up to two original root units, two crushing rounds per raw root at one energy. interfaces.effects: Food begins at its represented composition or the reviewed 50% root water assumption. Uncovered dry weather at 10–40 C removes at most 0.005 water mass per root per round to fraction 0.12; rain returns up to 0.01 per root, capped at original water. At fraction <=0.12 decay is 0.35 baseline, otherwise crushed food is 1.25 baseline. Exposure continues after unloading. No lost nutrients, reverse spoilage, sterilization or free materials.

Cancellation/death releases actual partial materials once. Assessment alone has no reward; a new verified paid separation can use existing grounded understanding.
